models.description: Smart Shot — automated shot planning. From a scene description plus optional subject references (characters, products, props) it writes a Shot Plan: a single production-design sheet with reference views, set design, a top-down camera floor plan, storyboard frames, and lighting notes. Use preview-shot-plan to see the plan alone; generate-shot-video to plan and render a video of the scene in one call.

image.description: Preview Shot Plan — produce the Shot Plan only, as a single wide image. Fast, cheap look at how the scene would be staged before committing to video. The result carries a videoPrompt and a ready-to-submit nextStep payload for rendering that exact plan into video. Pass reference images as plain URL strings (the `url` field of what openart_upload_sign / openart_upload_pick returned), NOT the whole visualReference object: subjects go in characterReferenceImageUrls (up to 3 — characters, products, props), the location in environmentReferenceImageUrl. Both are optional — a scene description alone is a complete request.

video.description: Generate Shot Video — plan the scene and render it in one call. Returns TWO assets: the video, plus the Shot Plan it was planned from. Costs the plan plus the video, so use preview-shot-plan first if the user is still exploring. Pass reference images as plain URL strings (the `url` field of what openart_upload_sign / openart_upload_pick returned), NOT the whole visualReference object: subjects go in characterReferenceImageUrls (up to 3 — characters, products, props), the location in environmentReferenceImageUrl. Both are optional — a scene description alone is a complete request.
